headline: Share India Securities Limited: Amalgamation/Merger

detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e., on November 06, 2026, has approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Ace Alpha Tech Limited with Share India Securities Limited with their respective shareholders and creditors.
